description: Add workout export functionality to complement existing ZWO and MRC parsers. Allow users to export built-in or custom workouts to Zwift (.zwo) or TrainerRoad (.mrc) formats for use in other applications.

phases.name: ZWO Export Implementation
phases.description: Implement the ZWO (Zwift workout) XML export functionality

subtasks.title: Implement segment-to-XML conversion helper
subtasks.description: Create helper function to convert WorkoutSegment to ZWO XML element string. Handle all segment types: Warmup, Cooldown, SteadyState, Intervals, FreeRide, Ramp.
acceptance_criteria: segment_to_xml helper function implemented
Warmup segments exported with PowerLow/PowerHigh attributes for ranges, or Power for constant
Cooldown segments exported with PowerLow/PowerHigh attributes for ranges
SteadyState segments exported with Power attribute
Intervals segments exported as SteadyState elements
FreeRide segments exported as FreeRide element
Ramp segments exported as Ramp element with range
Duration always included in seconds
Cadence attributes included when cadence_target present
subtasks.notes: Implemented segment_to_xml helper function and power_to_decimal helper. Handles all segment types: Warmup, Cooldown, SteadyState, Intervals (as SteadyState), FreeRide, and Ramp. Power values converted to ZWO decimal format (0.75 = 75% FTP). Duration in seconds, cadence attributes included when present (Cadence for single value, CadenceLow/CadenceHigh for range). Added 18 unit tests covering all segment types and edge cases.

subtasks.title: Implement export_zwo function
subtasks.description: Implement the main export_zwo function that converts a Workout to ZWO XML string. Follow the ZWO format with workout_file root, metadata elements (name, author, description), and workout element containing segments.
acceptance_criteria: Generates valid XML with <?xml version="1.0"?> declaration
Root element is <workout_file>
Name, author, description elements included when present
Tags exported as <tag name="..."/> elements
All segments converted within <workout> element
Returns Result<String, WorkoutExportError>
subtasks.notes: Implemented export_zwo function that converts Workout to ZWO XML string. Features: XML declaration (<?xml version="1.0"?>), workout_file root element, name/author/description metadata elements (when present), tags as <tag name="..."/> elements, workout element containing all segments. Added escape_xml and escape_xml_attr helper functions for XML special character escaping. Added 6 unit tests covering simple workout, metadata, special character escaping, and multiple segments.

subtasks.title: Implement export_zwo_to_file and generate_zwo_filename
subtasks.description: Add file writing function and filename generator for ZWO exports.
acceptance_criteria: export_zwo_to_file writes XML content to specified path
generate_zwo_filename creates filename from workout name with .zwo extension
Filename sanitized to remove invalid filesystem characters
subtasks.notes: Functions export_zwo_to_file and generate_zwo_filename were already implemented as part of subtask 1.2 during module creation. Implementation verified: export_zwo_to_file writes XML content via std::fs::write, generate_zwo_filename creates sanitized filename with .zwo extension using sanitize_filename helper that replaces filesystem-invalid characters (/ \\ : * ? \" < > |) with underscores. Tests included: test_generate_zwo_filename_simple, test_generate_zwo_filename_sanitizes_invalid_chars, test_sanitize_filename.

subtasks.title: Add unit tests for ZWO export

acceptance_criteria: Test exporting simple steady state workout
Test exporting warmup/cooldown with power ranges
Test exporting intervals
Test exporting workout with all metadata (name, author, description, tags)
Test exporting workout with cadence targets

Test round-trip: parse_zwo(export_zwo(workout)) produces equivalent workout
subtasks.notes:
Added 18 comprehensive unit tests for ZWO export covering all acceptance criteria:
- Test exporting simple steady state workout ✓
- Test exporting warmup/cooldown with power ranges ✓
- Test exporting intervals ✓ (exported as SteadyState)
- Test exporting workout with all metadata (name, author, description, tags) ✓
- Test exporting workout with cadence targets ✓ (both range and single value)

Additional edge case tests: very long duration, high/low power values, many segments, optional metadata fields, XML structure validation, special character escaping round-trip.

phases.name: MRC Export Implementation
phases.description: Implement the MRC (TrainerRoad) text format export functionality

subtasks.title: Implement segments-to-course-data conversion
subtasks.description: Create helper function to convert WorkoutSegment list to MRC COURSE DATA points. Handle power targets and ramps by creating appropriate time/power pairs.
acceptance_criteria: Converts segments to (time_minutes, power_percent) tuples
SteadyState creates two points at same power
Ramp/Warmup/Cooldown with Range creates points at start and end power
Time accumulates correctly across segments
Handles PercentFtp power targets directly
Handles Absolute power targets by converting to percentage (using optional FTP parameter or 100%)
subtasks.notes: Implemented segments_to_course_data helper function to convert WorkoutSegment list to MRC COURSE DATA points. Added power_to_percent helper for PowerTarget conversion. CourseDataPoint struct for internal representation. Handles all segment types: SteadyState, Intervals, FreeRide (0% power), Warmup/Cooldown/Ramp with Range (start/end power), Warmup/Cooldown/Ramp without Range (constant power). Time accumulates correctly across segments. Supports PercentFtp directly and Absolute with optional FTP parameter (default 200W). Added 17 comprehensive unit tests covering all acceptance criteria.

subtasks.title: Implement text events extraction
subtasks.description: Create helper to extract text events from segments for COURSE TEXT section.
acceptance_criteria: Extracts text_event from segments with their start times
Formats as MRC COURSE TEXT entries
Handles segments without text events gracefully
subtasks.notes:
Implemented TextEventEntry struct and helper functions for MRC COURSE TEXT section:
- extract_text_events(): Extracts text events from segments with their start times in minutes. Handles segments without text events gracefully by skipping them.
- format_text_event(): Formats entries as MRC COURSE TEXT lines with format `<minutes>\t"<text>"`

Added 10 comprehensive unit tests covering:
- Single segment with text event
- Multiple segments with mixed text events (some with, some without)
- All segments with text events
- Empty segments array
- Fractional minutes timing
- Text event formatting (simple, with time, fractional, long text)

subtasks.title: Implement export_mrc function
subtasks.description: Implement the main export_mrc function that converts a Workout to MRC format string.
acceptance_criteria: Generates valid MRC file structure
Includes [COURSE HEADER] with FILE NAME, DESCRIPTION
Includes [COURSE DATA] with time/power pairs
Includes [COURSE TEXT] when text events present
Proper section markers ([END COURSE HEADER], etc.)
Returns Result<String, WorkoutExportError>
subtasks.notes:
Implemented export_mrc and export_mrc_with_ftp functions to convert Workout structs to MRC format strings.

The MRC output includes:
- [COURSE HEADER] section with FILE NAME and optional DESCRIPTION
- [COURSE DATA] section with time/power percentage pairs (uses segments_to_course_data helper)
- [COURSE TEXT] section for text events when present (uses extract_text_events helper)

All acceptance criteria met:
- Generates valid MRC file structure ✓
- Includes [COURSE HEADER] with FILE NAME, DESCRIPTION ✓
- Includes [COURSE DATA] with time/power pairs ✓
- Includes [COURSE TEXT] when text events present ✓
- Proper section markers ([END COURSE HEADER], etc.) ✓
- Returns Result<String, WorkoutExportError> ✓

Added 7 unit tests: simple workout, with description, with text events, warmup/cooldown ramps, complete structure validation, and absolute power with FTP conversion.

Also added export_mrc_with_ftp to public exports in mod.rs for API flexibility.
